## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> wrapper in the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/metadata">Metadata</a> hierarchy.</p>


<p>This is a custom value handle that allows other metadata to refer to classes in the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> hierarchy.</p>


<p>Because of full uniquing support, each value is only wrapped by a single <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/valueasmetadata">ValueAsMetadata</a></em> object, so the lookup maps are far more efficient than those using <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/valuehandlebase">ValueHandleBase</a>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 454 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/metadata-h">Metadata.h</a>.</p>
